records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Adjusted EBITDA of $231.4 million increased 16% and was 28.7% of adjusted net sales, up 70 basis points.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •The change in organic sales for both the three and nine months ended September 30, 2022 was driven by increases in the Fire & Safety reporting unit due to price realization, backlog execution and strong acceptance of targeted growth initiatives.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Additionally, there were increases in the Sealing Solutions reporting unit driven by favorable performance in the oil and gas, automotive and industrial markets which more than offset customer supply chain driven softness in the semiconductor market and increases in the Performance Pneumatics Technologies reporting unit driven by strength in the industrial market, price capture and targeted growth initiatives tied to fuel cells.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Operating margin of 24.5% was up 190 basis points.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjusted operating income increased 16% to $201.1 million.
